title: CLEAN removes C0 control code units (< 32) and preserves UTF-16 supplementary pairs; calc-func also strips five Windows-1252 C1 code units (129, 141, 143, 144, 157)
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527.20088, CLEAN(text) coerces numbers and logicals via worksheet text coercion (CLEAN(123) -> "123"), removes C0 control code units below 32 (CHAR(7), CHAR(10)), and preserves supplementary UTF-16 surrogate pairs such as UNICHAR(128512) (U+1F600). In calc-func's ported kernel (text_kernels.rs), CLEAN also strips the five unassigned Windows-1252 C1 code units 129, 141, 143, 144, and 157. All 2,082 full-bank CLEAN rows match.
basis: Measured in DnaCalc f2_rows row 20, dcfl2_text row 49, and jnt_text_formats rows 76-78 (Excel 16.0.20527.20088); 2,082/2,082 full-bank rows match.
